cases.prompt: Enroll our open source C library in OSS-Fuzz. We already have a libFuzzer harness in fuzz/parse_fuzzer.c.
expectations: Creates projects/<name>/ with project.yaml, a Dockerfile based on the OSS-Fuzz base-builder image, and build.sh.
Clones the source in the Dockerfile rather than in build.sh, and build.sh links the harness with $CC/$CFLAGS and $LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE into $OUT.
Tests locally with infra/helper.py (build_image, build_fuzzers, run_fuzzer) before opening the pull request.

cases.prompt: OSS-Fuzz reported a crash in project `libfoo`, harness `parse_fuzzer`. How do I build and run it locally to reproduce?

any.why: runs the harness on the test case

expectations: Clones google/oss-fuzz and runs `infra/helper.py build_image libfoo` and `build_fuzzers --sanitizer=address libfoo` (or the sanitizer from the report).
Runs the harness against the downloaded test case (for example `helper.py reproduce libfoo parse_fuzzer <testcase>`).
